### `agents.delete`

Delete an AgentFlow agent

`DELETE /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents/{agent}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `agents_delete`

Remove an agent. Its direct reports move up to its manager, and workflow steps it ran become unassigned.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `agent` | string | yes | Agent id or name. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `deleted` | string | yes |  |

**Example: Remove the researcher**

```sh
curl -sS -X DELETE "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/agents/Researcher" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "rev": 58,
  "deleted": "a1"
}
```

### `runners.list`

List AgentFlow runners

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/runners` · scope `read` · MCP tool `runners_list`

Machines or services that run agents, with the models each one offers, as they last reported (runners.report). An agent's runtime names a runner and its models are some of that runner's model ids. Each model may say its provider (a display group) and billing (included or metered).

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].name` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].models` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].jobs` | object[] |  |  |
| `items[].timezone` | string |  |  |
| `items[].reported` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].jobsReported` | string |  |  |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

**Example: Runners**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/runners" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "name": "Home server",
      "models": [
        {
          "id": "claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5",
          "label": "Claude · Sonnet 5.5",
          "provider": "Claude",
          "billing": "included"
        }
      ],
      "jobs": [],
      "reported": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null,
  "rev": 42
}
```

### `runners.report`

Report a runner and its models

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/runners/{runner}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `runners_report`

A runner says what it can run, and optionally which scheduled jobs it found (systemd timers, cron, hosted crons...). The model list replaces the old one when sent (leave models out to keep the stored ones, e.g. when a runner reports the jobs of another machine it reaches over SSH), and so does jobs (leave it out to keep the stored jobs; [] clears them). Nothing is saved when nothing changed, so a runner may report on every pass: a report that only moves lastRun or nextRun is not saved either, unless the jobs were last saved 6 hours ago or more (jobsReported); a changed lastStatus, job or field always is. Agents name the runner in runtime and pick model ids; jobs show in the AgentFlow Scheduled tray, where they can be promoted into the org. A job can carry its full schedule: its timezone, every trigger with its raw expression, where it was read (origin, and the repo file), drift from the live schedule on the platform, and a note on conditions its script applies. Give each model a provider to group it by, and billing: included (a subscription or free) or metered (paid per use), which runners prefer included models by when picking automatically. Up to 20 runners, 1500 models and 500 jobs each.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `runner` | string | yes | Runner name, e.g. Home server. |
| `models` | object[] |  | The models this runner can run (replaces the stored list; leave out to keep it). |
| `models[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `models[].label` | string |  |  |
| `models[].provider` | string |  | Display group, e.g. Claude or OpenCode. |
| `models[].billing` | enum |  | included (a subscription or free) or metered (paid per use). One of `included`, `metered`. |
| `jobs` | object[] |  | Scheduled jobs on this runner (replaces the stored list; leave out to keep it, [] to clear). |
| `jobs[].id` | string | yes | Stable per runner, e.g. systemd:backup.timer or vercel:my-app:/api/cron/sync. |
| `jobs[].name` | string |  | Defaults to the id. |
| `jobs[].source` | string |  | Where it is scheduled: systemd, cron, t3, vercel, railway, aside, windows, claude, codex, github or other (any text; defaults to other). |
| `jobs[].group` | string |  | Display group, e.g. "Home server" or "Vercel · my-app". |
| `jobs[].schedule` | string |  | When, in words, e.g. "Daily 22:30" or "Every 5 min". |
| `jobs[].cron` | string |  | The cron expression, when there is one. |
| `jobs[].timezone` | string |  | The zone its times are in: an IANA name such as America/Phoenix, "UTC", or "local" (the runner's own; see timezone on the runner). |
| `jobs[].triggers` | object[] |  | Every rule it fires on, e.g. each OnCalendar line of a systemd timer or each trigger of a Windows task. |
| `jobs[].origin` | enum |  | Where the schedule was read: repo (a config file in a repo; see file), platform (the hosting platform's API) or machine (the machine's own scheduler). One of `repo`, `platform`, `machine`. |
| `jobs[].file` | string |  | The repo-relative path of the config it came from, e.g. services/worker/railway.json. |
| `jobs[].drift` | string |  | How the platform's live schedule differs from the repo file, when it does. |
| `jobs[].note` | string |  | Conditions the job's script applies itself, e.g. "Exits early when nothing changed". |
| `jobs[].command` | string |  | A short summary of what it runs. |
| `jobs[].ai` | boolean |  | It starts an AI agent (promoted as an AI agent rather than an automation). |
| `jobs[].enabled` | boolean |  |  |
| `jobs[].lastRun` | string |  | ISO time of the last run. |
| `jobs[].lastStatus` | enum |  | One of `ok`, `failed`, `running`, `unknown`. |
| `jobs[].nextRun` | string |  | ISO time of the next run. |
| `timezone` | string |  | The runner machine's time zone (an IANA name), which jobs with timezone "local" are in. Left out, the stored one stays. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `runner` | object | yes |  |
| `runner.name` | string | yes |  |
| `runner.models` | object[] | yes |  |
| `runner.jobs` | object[] |  |  |
| `runner.timezone` | string |  |  |
| `runner.reported` | string | yes |  |
| `runner.jobsReported` | string |  |  |
| `changed` | boolean | yes |  |

**Example: Home server**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/runners/Home%20server" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"models":[{"id":"claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5","label":"Claude · Sonnet 5.5","provider":"Claude","billing":"included"}]}'
```

```json
{
  "rev": 59,
  "runner": {
    "name": "Home server",
    "models": [
      {
        "id": "claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5",
        "label": "Claude · Sonnet 5.5",
        "provider": "Claude",
        "billing": "included"
      }
    ],
    "jobs": [],
    "reported": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
  },
  "changed": true
}
```

**Example: With scheduled jobs**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/runners/Home%20server" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"models":[{"id":"claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5","label":"Claude · Sonnet 5.5"}],"jobs":[{"id":"systemd:backup.timer","name":"Nightly backup","source":"systemd","group":"Home server","schedule":"Daily 22:30","cron":"30 22 * * *","timezone":"America/Phoenix","triggers":[{"kind":"calendar","expr":"*-*-* 22:30:00","text":"Daily 22:30"}],"origin":"machine","command":"restic backup /srv","ai":false,"enabled":true,"lastRun":"2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z","lastStatus":"ok","nextRun":"2026-10-30T22:30:00.000Z"}]}'
```

```json
{
  "rev": 60,
  "runner": {
    "name": "Home server",
    "models": [
      {
        "id": "claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5",
        "label": "Claude · Sonnet 5.5",
        "provider": "Claude",
        "billing": "included"
      }
    ],
    "jobs": [
      {
        "id": "systemd:backup.timer",
        "name": "Nightly backup",
        "source": "systemd",
        "group": "Home server",
        "schedule": "Daily 22:30",
        "cron": "30 22 * * *",
        "timezone": "America/Phoenix",
        "triggers": [
          {
            "kind": "calendar",
            "expr": "*-*-* 22:30:00",
            "text": "Daily 22:30"
          }
        ],
        "origin": "machine",
        "command": "restic backup /srv",
        "ai": false,
        "enabled": true,
        "lastRun": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
        "lastStatus": "ok",
        "nextRun": "2026-10-30T22:30:00.000Z"
      }
    ],
    "reported": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
    "jobsReported": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
  },
  "changed": true
}
```

## AgentFlow workflows

### `workflows.list`

List AgentFlow workflows

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/workflows` · scope `read` · MCP tool `workflows_list`

Workflows: ordered steps, each handled by an agent, started by hand, on a schedule or by an event. Filters: status, agent (id or name: workflows with a step it runs), project and q.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `status` | enum |  | One of `draft`, `active`, `paused`. |
| `agent` | string |  | Agent id or name. |
| `project` | string |  | Project id or name. |
| `q` | string |  |  |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].name` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].description` | string |  |  |
| `items[].status` | enum | yes | One of `draft`, `active`, `paused`. |
| `items[].trigger` | enum | yes | One of `manual`, `schedule`, `event`. |
| `items[].schedule` | string |  |  |
| `items[].steps` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].projects` | string[] | yes |  |
| `items[].cards` | string[] | yes |  |
| `items[].items` | string[] | yes |  |
| `items[].created` | string |  |  |
| `items[].updated` | string |  |  |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

**Example: Workflows the researcher is in**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/workflows?agent=Researcher" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "w1",
      "name": "Ship a card",
      "description": "",
      "status": "active",
      "trigger": "event",
      "schedule": "A card enters Doing",
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "s1",
          "agent": "a1",
          "action": "Research the approach",
          "output": "Notes on the card"
        }
      ],
      "projects": [
        "p1"
      ],
      "cards": [],
      "items": [],
      "created": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
      "updated": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null,
  "rev": 42
}
```

### `workflows.get`

Get an AgentFlow workflow and its brief

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/workflows/{workflow}` · scope `read` · MCP tool `workflows_get`

One workflow by id or name, with `brief`: Markdown listing its trigger, its steps with the agent for each, and its linked projects, cards and deadlines.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `workflow` | string | yes | Workflow id or name. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `workflow` | object | yes |  |
| `workflow.id` | string | yes |  |
| `workflow.name` | string | yes |  |
| `workflow.description` | string |  |  |
| `workflow.status` | enum | yes | One of `draft`, `active`, `paused`. |
| `workflow.trigger` | enum | yes | One of `manual`, `schedule`, `event`. |
| `workflow.schedule` | string |  |  |

## Search

### `search`

Search an environment

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/search` · scope `read` · MCP tool `search`

Case-insensitive search over chart nodes (name, notes), projects, timeline items (title, notes), cards (#number, title, description), AgentFlow agents (name, role, purpose) and workflows (name, description). `types` narrows it (comma-separated in a query string).

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `q` | string | yes |  |
| `types` | enum[] |  |  |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].type` | enum | yes | One of `node`, `project`, `item`, `card`, `agent`, `workflow`. |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].title` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].chart` | string |  |  |
| `items[].number` | integer |  |  |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

**Example: Sign-up**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/search?q=sign-up" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "type": "card",
      "id": "k1",
      "title": "Build sign-up form",
      "number": 12
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null,
  "rev": 42
}
```

## Sharing

### `shares.list`

List shares of an environment

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/shares` · scope `read` · MCP tool `shares_list`

Who you share this environment (or parts of it) with: each share's recipient, permission, scope in words and counts, plus the pending re-share requests on them (approve or deny with shares.requests.decide). Only the environment's owner can list them; anyone else gets 404.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shares` | object[] | yes |  |
| `shares[].id` | string | null | yes | null in a preview of a share that does not exist yet. |
| `shares[].ownerEnv` | string | yes |  |
| `shares[].ownerEnvName` | string |  |  |
| `shares[].ownerEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `shares[].recipientEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `shares[].permission` | enum | yes | One of `view`, `comment`, `edit`. |
| `shares[].adds` | enum |  | What the recipient may add (edit shares only). One of `off`, `approve`, `direct`. |
| `shares[].scope` | object | yes |  |
| `shares[].name` | string |  |  |
| `shares[].createdAt` | string | yes |  |
| `shares[].createdBy` | string |  | Email of the owner who shared it. |
| `shares[].actor` | string | null |  | The API key (or MCP connector) that created it, by name; null when made in the app. Settings › Sharing shows it as "Created by". |
| `shares[].via` | string | null |  | The re-share request it was approved from, if any. |
| `shares[].revokedAt` | string | null | yes |  |
| `shares[].scopeLabel` | string | yes | What it holds, in words. |
| `shares[].summary` | union |  |  |

### `shares.preview`

Preview what a share would show

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/shares/preview` · scope `read` · MCP tool `shares_preview`

Exactly what a recipient would see for a scope, before you share: chart cards, co-owner stubs (name only), projects, timeline items and DevOps cards, with counts and a tip when the scope may surprise people. Nothing is stored. Owner only.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `scope` | object | yes | What to share. Names are matched like everywhere else (id first, then the name, ignoring case), against your own records. |
| `scope.kind` | enum | yes | environment (everything in it), project (a project with its timeline items and DevOps cards), label (the DevOps cards with a label), person (a chart card and everything connected below it, with their projects) or nodes (hand-picked chart cards, nothing below them). One of `environment`, `project`, `label`, `person`, `nodes`. |
| `scope.project` | string |  | For kind project: the project, id or name. |
| `scope.label` | string |  | For kind label: the DevOps label, id or name. |
| `scope.node` | string |  | For kind person: the chart card to start from (a person or any card), id or name. |
| `scope.nodes` | string[] |  | For kind nodes: the chart cards, ids or names. |
| `scope.chart` | string |  | Optional: only this chart's cards and lines (chart id or name, or "active"). |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preview` | object | yes |  |
| `preview.nodes` | object[] | yes | Chart cards the recipient will see. |
| `preview.stubs` | object[] | yes | Co-owners shown by name only (read only). |
| `preview.projects` | object[] | yes |  |
| `preview.items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `preview.cards` | object[] | yes |  |
| `preview.summary` | object | yes |  |
| `preview.tip` | string | null | yes |  |
| `label` | string | yes | The scope in words, as Settings › Sharing shows it. |

**Example: Project Lantern by name**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/shares/preview" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"scope":{"kind":"project","project":"Lantern"}}'
```

```json
{
  "preview": {
    "nodes": [],
    "stubs": [],
    "projects": [
      {
        "id": "p1",
        "name": "Lantern",
        "color": "#7cb980"
      }
    ],
    "items": [
      {
        "id": "i1",
        "title": "Public beta",
        "kind": "release",
        "start": "2026-12-01"
      }
    ],
    "cards": [
      {
        "id": "k1",
        "number": 12,
        "title": "Build sign-up form",
        "project": "p1"
      }
    ],
    "summary": {
      "nodes": 0,
      "stubs": 0,
      "projects": 1,
      "items": 1,
      "cards": 1
    },
    "tip": null
  },
  "label": "Project Lantern"
}
```

### `shares.create`

Share part of an environment with someone

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/shares` · scope `write` · MCP tool `shares_create`

Gives another Flow user (by email) access to part of your environment: they see it as linked records they can add to their own environments, and edit or comment when the permission allows. Two steps, because this grants a person access to data: without confirm: true it only answers with the preview (what they would see) and stores nothing (200, created false). Show that preview to your user and ask them before you call again with confirm: true, which creates the share (201). Sharing the same scope with the same person again changes the permission instead (existing true). Only the environment's owner can share it; records shared with you (ids sh.…) cannot be shared on: ask their owner with shares.requests.create. Needs a key with write access to this environment. The share records the key's name, shown in Settings › Sharing as "Created by".

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `recipientEmail` | string | yes | Who to share with: their email (the account they sign in to Flow with). |
| `scope` | object | yes | What to share. Names are matched like everywhere else (id first, then the name, ignoring case), against your own records. |
| `scope.kind` | enum | yes | environment (everything in it), project (a project with its timeline items and DevOps cards), label (the DevOps cards with a label), person (a chart card and everything connected below it, with their projects) or nodes (hand-picked chart cards, nothing below them). One of `environment`, `project`, `label`, `person`, `nodes`. |
| `scope.project` | string |  | For kind project: the project, id or name. |
| `scope.label` | string |  | For kind label: the DevOps label, id or name. |
| `scope.node` | string |  | For kind person: the chart card to start from (a person or any card), id or name. |
| `scope.nodes` | string[] |  | For kind nodes: the chart cards, ids or names. |
| `scope.chart` | string |  | Optional: only this chart's cards and lines (chart id or name, or "active"). |
| `permission` | enum |  | view (read only), comment (read and comment) or edit (change the shared fields and comment). One of `view`, `comment`, `edit`. |
| `adds` | enum |  | Edit shares only: what the recipient may add to your environment inside the share (cards, timeline items, projects, mind map cards). off (the default), approve (each addition waits for you: proposals.list, proposals.approve, proposals.deny) or direct (added at once). View and comment shares are always off. One of `off`, `approve`, `direct`. |
| `name` | string |  | Optional label for the share. |
| `confirm` | boolean |  | false (the default): preview only, nothing is shared. true: create the share. Only send true after your user has seen the preview and agreed. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `created` | boolean | yes | True when this call created a new share. |
| `existing` | boolean | yes | The same scope is already shared with this person (its permission is changed on confirm). |
| `confirmed` | boolean | yes | Whether confirm was true. false: nothing was stored. |
| `share` | object | yes |  |
| `share.id` | string | null | yes | null in a preview of a share that does not exist yet. |
| `share.ownerEnv` | string | yes |  |
| `share.ownerEnvName` | string |  |  |
| `share.ownerEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `share.recipientEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `share.permission` | enum | yes | One of `view`, `comment`, `edit`. |
| `share.adds` | enum |  | What the recipient may add (edit shares only). One of `off`, `approve`, `direct`. |
| `share.scope` | object | yes |  |
| `share.name` | string |  |  |
| `share.createdAt` | string | yes |  |
| `share.createdBy` | string |  | Email of the owner who shared it. |
| `share.actor` | string | null |  | The API key (or MCP connector) that created it, by name; null when made in the app. Settings › Sharing shows it as "Created by". |
| `share.via` | string | null |  | The re-share request it was approved from, if any. |
| `share.revokedAt` | string | null | yes |  |
| `share.scopeLabel` | string | yes | What it holds, in words. |
| `share.summary` | union |  |  |
| `share.tip` | string | null |  | A note when the scope may not hold what people expect (e.g. mind map cards but no DevOps cards). |
| `preview` | object | yes |  |
| `preview.nodes` | object[] | yes | Chart cards the recipient will see. |
| `preview.stubs` | object[] | yes | Co-owners shown by name only (read only). |
| `preview.projects` | object[] | yes |  |
| `preview.items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `preview.cards` | object[] | yes |  |
| `preview.summary` | object | yes |  |
| `preview.tip` | string | null | yes |  |
| `label` | string | yes |  |

**Example: Preview first: project Lantern with edit access**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/shares" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"recipientEmail":"bo@example.com","scope":{"kind":"project","project":"Lantern"},"permission":"edit"}'
```

```json
      "kind": "project",

    },
    "name": "",
    "createdAt": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
    "createdBy": "owner@example.test",
```

### `shares.update`

Change a share's permission

`PATCH /api/v1/shares/{share}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `shares_update`

Set what the recipient may do: permission view, comment or edit, and for edit shares adds (whether they may add records). Send either or both. Lowering an edit share to view or comment turns additions off. Owner only (anyone else gets 404); a revoked share gets 409.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `share` | string | yes | Share id (from shares.list or shares.incoming). |
| `permission` | enum |  | view (read only), comment (read and comment) or edit (change the shared fields and comment). One of `view`, `comment`, `edit`. |
| `adds` | enum |  | Edit shares only: what the recipient may add to your environment inside the share (cards, timeline items, projects, mind map cards). off (the default), approve (each addition waits for you: proposals.list, proposals.approve, proposals.deny) or direct (added at once). View and comment shares are always off. One of `off`, `approve`, `direct`. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `share` | object | yes |  |
| `share.id` | string | null | yes | null in a preview of a share that does not exist yet. |
| `share.ownerEnv` | string | yes |  |
| `share.ownerEnvName` | string |  |  |
| `share.ownerEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `share.recipientEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `share.permission` | enum | yes | One of `view`, `comment`, `edit`. |
| `share.adds` | enum |  | What the recipient may add (edit shares only). One of `off`, `approve`, `direct`. |
| `share.scope` | object | yes |  |
| `share.name` | string |  |  |
| `share.createdAt` | string | yes |  |
| `share.createdBy` | string |  | Email of the owner who shared it. |
| `share.actor` | string | null |  | The API key (or MCP connector) that created it, by name; null when made in the app. Settings › Sharing shows it as "Created by". |
| `share.via` | string | null |  | The re-share request it was approved from, if any. |
| `share.revokedAt` | string | null | yes |  |
| `share.scopeLabel` | string | yes | What it holds, in words. |
| `share.summary` | union |  |  |
| `share.tip` | string | null |  | A note when the scope may not hold what people expect (e.g. mind map cards but no DevOps cards). |

**Example: Down to view**

```sh
curl -sS -X PATCH "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/shares/6f1c2a4e-0b7d-4c55-9a3e-2d8f1b0c9e11" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"permission":"view"}'
```

```json
{
  "share": {
    "id": "6f1c2a4e-0b7d-4c55-9a3e-2d8f1b0c9e11",
    "ownerEnv": "default-workspace",
    "ownerEnvName": "Default workspace",
    "ownerEmail": "owner@example.test",
    "recipientEmail": "bo@example.com",
    "permission": "view",
    "adds": "off",
    "scope": {
      "kind": "project",
      "projectId": "p1"
    },
    "name": "",
    "createdAt": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
    "createdBy": "owner@example.test",
    "actor": "Laptop agent",
    "via": null,
    "revokedAt": null,
    "scopeLabel": "Project Lantern",
    "summary": {
      "nodes": 0,
      "stubs": 0,
      "projects": 1,
      "items": 1,
      "cards": 4
    },
    "tip": null
  }
}
```

**Example: Let them add, with your approval**

### `shares.revoke`

Revoke a share

`DELETE /api/v1/shares/{share}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `shares_revoke`

Stop sharing: the linked records leave every environment of the recipient's on their next read (their own records stay). The share and its history are kept, marked revoked. Owner only.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `share` | string | yes | Share id (from shares.list or shares.incoming). |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `share` | object | yes |  |
| `share.id` | string | null | yes | null in a preview of a share that does not exist yet. |
| `share.ownerEnv` | string | yes |  |
| `share.ownerEnvName` | string |  |  |
| `share.ownerEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `share.recipientEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `share.permission` | enum | yes | One of `view`, `comment`, `edit`. |
| `share.adds` | enum |  | What the recipient may add (edit shares only). One of `off`, `approve`, `direct`. |
| `share.scope` | object | yes |  |
| `share.name` | string |  |  |
| `share.createdAt` | string | yes |  |
| `share.createdBy` | string |  | Email of the owner who shared it. |
| `share.actor` | string | null |  | The API key (or MCP connector) that created it, by name; null when made in the app. Settings › Sharing shows it as "Created by". |
| `share.via` | string | null |  | The re-share request it was approved from, if any. |
| `share.revokedAt` | string | null | yes |  |
| `share.scopeLabel` | string | yes | What it holds, in words. |
| `share.summary` | union |  |  |
| `share.tip` | string | null |  | A note when the scope may not hold what people expect (e.g. mind map cards but no DevOps cards). |
| `revoked` | boolean | yes |  |

**Example: Revoke**


### `shares.requests.create`

Ask the owner to share it on

`POST /api/v1/shares/{share}/requests` · scope `write` · MCP tool `shares_requests_create`

You cannot share what is shared with you, but you can ask its owner to share the same records with someone else. The permission defaults to yours and cannot be more than yours. The owner approves (maybe at a lower permission) or denies it in Settings › Sharing or with shares.requests.decide.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `share` | string | yes | Share id (from shares.list or shares.incoming). |
| `toEmail` | string | yes | Who it should be shared with. |
| `permission` | enum |  | view (read only), comment (read and comment) or edit (change the shared fields and comment). One of `view`, `comment`, `edit`. |
| `note` | string |  | A note for the owner. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `request` | object | yes |  |
| `request.id` | string | yes |  |
| `request.shareId` | string | yes |  |
| `request.ownerEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `request.requestedBy` | string | yes |  |
| `request.toEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `request.permission` | enum | yes | One of `view`, `comment`, `edit`. |
| `request.note` | string |  |  |
| `request.status` | enum | yes | One of `pending`, `approved`, `denied`. |
| `request.createdAt` | string | yes |  |
| `request.decidedAt` | string | null |  |  |
| `request.decidedBy` | string | null |  |  |
| `request.newShareId` | string | null |  |  |

**Example: Ask to share with Kim**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/shares/6f1c2a4e-0b7d-4c55-9a3e-2d8f1b0c9e11/requests" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"toEmail":"kim@example.com","permission":"view","note":"Kim helps with the launch"}'
```

```json
{
  "request": {
    "id": "0c7e9a52-3b1d-4f0e-8a6c-5d2b9e4f1a77",
    "shareId": "6f1c2a4e-0b7d-4c55-9a3e-2d8f1b0c9e11",
    "ownerEmail": "owner@example.test",
    "requestedBy": "bo@example.com",
    "toEmail": "kim@example.com",
    "permission": "view",
    "note": "Kim helps with the launch",
    "status": "pending",
    "createdAt": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
    "decidedAt": null,
    "decidedBy": null,
    "newShareId": null
  }
}
```

### `shares.requests.decide`

Approve or deny a re-share request

`POST /api/v1/share-requests/{request}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `shares_requests_decide`

The owner's answer to a request from shares.requests.list. approve: true creates a new share of the same scope with the person asked for, at the requested permission or the lower one you pass; false denies it. Like shares.create, approving grants a person access: show the request to your user first. A request already decided gets 409.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `request` | string | yes | Request id. |
| `approve` | boolean | yes |  |
| `permission` | enum |  | Optional: approve at this permission (not more than requested). One of `view`, `comment`, `edit`. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `request` | object | yes |  |
| `request.id` | string | yes |  |
| `request.shareId` | string | yes |  |
| `request.ownerEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `request.requestedBy` | string | yes |  |
| `request.toEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `request.permission` | enum | yes | One of `view`, `comment`, `edit`. |
| `request.note` | string |  |  |
| `request.status` | enum | yes | One of `pending`, `approved`, `denied`. |
| `request.createdAt` | string | yes |  |
| `request.decidedAt` | string | null |  |  |
| `request.decidedBy` | string | null |  |  |
| `request.newShareId` | string | null |  |  |
| `share` | union | yes | The new share when approved; null when denied. |

**Example: Approve at view**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/share-requests/0c7e9a52-3b1d-4f0e-8a6c-5d2b9e4f1a77" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"approve":true,"permission":"view"}'
```

### `proposals.list`

List share additions

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/proposals` · scope `read` · MCP tool `proposals_list`

Records that recipients of this environment's edit shares added while their share needs your approval (role owner), and the ones you added from this environment to someone else's share (role proposer). status: pending (the default), approved, denied, withdrawn, or applied (added at once by a share that allows it). preview says what each one adds. Decide with proposals.approve or proposals.deny; set what a share allows in the app (Settings › Sharing).

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `status` | enum |  | One of `pending`, `approved`, `denied`, `applied`, `withdrawn`. |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].shareId` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].env` | string | yes | The environment of the share's owner. |
| `items[].proposedBy` | string | yes | Who added them (the share's recipient). |
| `items[].status` | enum | yes | One of `pending`, `approved`, `denied`, `applied`, `withdrawn`. |
| `items[].role` | enum |  | owner: yours to approve or deny; proposer: you added it to someone else's share. One of `owner`, `proposer`. |
| `items[].createdAt` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].updatedAt` | string |  |  |
| `items[].decidedAt` | string | null |  |  |
| `items[].decidedBy` | string | null |  |  |
| `items[].preview` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].records` | object |  | The records as they would land in the owner's data, by kind (node, edge, project, item, card). Owner only. |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

**Example: Waiting for you**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/proposals" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
      "env": "default-workspace",
      "proposedBy": "kim@example.test",
      "status": "pending",
      "role": "owner",
      "createdAt": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
      "decidedAt": null,
      "decidedBy": null,
      "preview": [
        {
          "kind": "card",
          "id": "k9",
          "title": "Draft the launch email",
          "detail": "Lantern"
        }
      ],
      "records": {
        "node": [],
        "edge": [],
        "project": [],
        "item": [],
        "card": [
          {
            "id": "k9",
            "title": "Draft the launch email",
            "column": "requests",
            "project": "p1"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null,
  "rev": 42
}
```

### `proposals.approve`

Approve a share addition

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/proposals/{proposal}/approve` · scope `write` · MCP tool `proposals_approve`

Add a pending proposal's records to this environment, owned by you (cards get your next numbers). The recipient then sees them as ordinary shared records. Only the environment's owner can; a decided one is refused with 409 proposal_decided, and one that no longer fits its share (what it was added to is gone or no longer shared) with 409 proposal_out_of_scope.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `proposal` | string | yes | Proposal id (proposals.list). |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `proposal` | object | yes |  |
| `proposal.id` | string | yes |  |
| `proposal.shareId` | string | yes |  |
| `proposal.env` | string | yes | The environment of the share's owner. |
| `proposal.proposedBy` | string | yes | Who added them (the share's recipient). |
| `proposal.status` | enum | yes | One of `pending`, `approved`, `denied`, `applied`, `withdrawn`. |
| `proposal.role` | enum |  | owner: yours to approve or deny; proposer: you added it to someone else's share. One of `owner`, `proposer`. |
| `proposal.createdAt` | string | yes |  |
| `proposal.updatedAt` | string |  |  |
| `proposal.decidedAt` | string | null |  |  |
| `proposal.decidedBy` | string | null |  |  |
| `proposal.preview` | object[] | yes |  |
| `proposal.records` | object |  | The records as they would land in the owner's data, by kind (node, edge, project, item, card). Owner only. |

**Example: Approve**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/proposals/5b0c7f2e-61d4-4e0f-9c8a-3f1e2d4c5b6a/approve" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "proposal": {
    "id": "5b0c7f2e-61d4-4e0f-9c8a-3f1e2d4c5b6a",
    "shareId": "9a7e3c1b-2d4f-4b6a-8c0e-1f3a5b7d9e2c",
    "env": "default-workspace",
    "proposedBy": "kim@example.test",
    "status": "approved",
    "role": "owner",
    "createdAt": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
    "decidedAt": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
    "decidedBy": "owner@example.test",
    "preview": [
      {
        "kind": "card",
        "id": "k9",
        "title": "Draft the launch email",
        "detail": "Lantern"
      }
    ],
    "records": {
      "node": [],
      "edge": [],
      "project": [],
      "item": [],
      "card": [
        {
          "id": "k9",
          "title": "Draft the launch email",
          "column": "requests",
          "project": "p1"
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

### `proposals.deny`

Deny a share addition

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/proposals/{proposal}/deny` · scope `write` · MCP tool `proposals_deny`

Turn down a pending proposal. Nothing is added; the recipient's pending copy disappears and they are told it was denied. A decided one is refused with 409 proposal_decided.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `proposal` | string | yes | Proposal id (proposals.list). |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `proposal` | object | yes |  |
| `proposal.id` | string | yes |  |
| `proposal.shareId` | string | yes |  |
| `proposal.env` | string | yes | The environment of the share's owner. |
| `proposal.proposedBy` | string | yes | Who added them (the share's recipient). |
| `proposal.status` | enum | yes | One of `pending`, `approved`, `denied`, `applied`, `withdrawn`. |
| `proposal.role` | enum |  | owner: yours to approve or deny; proposer: you added it to someone else's share. One of `owner`, `proposer`. |
| `proposal.createdAt` | string | yes |  |
| `proposal.updatedAt` | string |  |  |
| `proposal.decidedAt` | string | null |  |  |
| `proposal.decidedBy` | string | null |  |  |
| `proposal.preview` | object[] | yes |  |
| `proposal.records` | object |  | The records as they would land in the owner's data, by kind (node, edge, project, item, card). Owner only. |

**Example: Deny**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/proposals/5b0c7f2e-61d4-4e0f-9c8a-3f1e2d4c5b6a/deny" \
```


## 3D office

### `office.agents.report`

Report your live coding agents

`PUT /api/v1/office/agents` · scope `write` · MCP tool `office_agents_report`

A reporter on your machine (flow office bridge, or any integration) sends every coding agent running there, every few seconds. Agents belong to you (the key's owner) and show at your desk in the 3D office of every environment you are a member of, or, working on an AgentFlow agent's card (agentflow, or a title such as "[Flow] Builder: #12 …"), at that agent's desk in the common area. Each source replaces only its own set, and a source that has not reported for 90 seconds is gone. Others see an agent's details only when its repo belongs to a project they can see (projects.update repos); otherwise just its mascot and status, as "Private project". An optional usage object ({tokens, costUsd} for the reporter’s local day) contributes to that person's room meter when the viewer can see the agent. The office bridge sends measured usage and estimates cost at API list prices. Up to 200 agents and 20 children each are kept, and long strings are cut. The answer holds the actions from the office that this source has not been sent yet (also served by office.actions.wait): Allow / Deny answers, and messages and stops for agents that list them in can.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | string | yes | The reporter, e.g. "bridge:laptop". Each source replaces only its own agents. |
| `at` | string |  | When the reporter read its agents (ISO time). |
| `agents` | any[] | yes |  |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `actions` | object[] | yes |  |
| `actions[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `actions[].agentId` | string | yes |  |
| `actions[].source` | string |  |  |
| `actions[].kind` | enum | yes | answer: Allow / Deny (requestId, decision); message: send text as a new user turn; stop: interrupt its running turn. Treat a missing kind as answer. One of `answer`, `message`, `stop`. |
| `actions[].requestId` | string |  | answer only. |
| `actions[].decision` | enum |  | answer only. One of `allow`, `deny`. |
| `actions[].text` | string |  | message only: what its owner wrote. |
| `actions[].at` | string | yes |  |
| `actions[].result` | object |  |  |
| `accepted` | integer |  | How many agents were kept. |

**Example: One agent waiting on a prompt**

```sh
curl -sS -X PUT "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/office/agents" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"source":"bridge:laptop","at":"2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z","agents":[{"id":"laptop:t3:thread-abc","title":"Fix login bug","vendor":"claude","model":"Opus 5.5","status":"waiting","activity":"Waiting for approval","activityKind":"test","host":"laptop","hostLabel":"laptop · T3","repo":{"name":"flow","remote":"https://github.com/acme/flow.git"},"children":[],"pending":{"requestId":"req-1","kind":"approval","summary":"Run: npm test","can":["allow","deny"]},"agentflow":{"agent":"Builder","card":12},"can":["message","stop"],"transcript":[{"role":"user","text":"Fix the login redirect loop.","at":"2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"},{"role":"assistant","text":"The callback keeps ?next=/login. Running the tests next.","at":"2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"},{"role":"tool","text":"Run: npm test","at":"2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"}]}]}'
```

```json
{
  "actions": [],
  "accepted": 1
}
```

### `office.agents.list`

List your reported agents

`GET /api/v1/office/agents` · scope `read` · MCP tool `office_agents_list`

Your live agents as Flow holds them (every source that reported in the last 90 seconds), in full, and the sources.

**Input**: see schema

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agents` | object[] | yes |  |
| `agents[].id` | string | yes | Stable and unique within the source, e.g. "laptop:t3:thread-abc". |
| `agents[].title` | string |  | What it is working on (up to 200 characters). |
| `agents[].vendor` | string |  | Which mascot it gets: claude, codex, gemini, deepseek, grok or other (other: picked from the model when it names one). |
| `agents[].model` | string |  | Display name, e.g. "Opus 5.5". |
| `agents[].status` | string |  | running (working), waiting (on its person: a permission prompt or a question) or idle. |
| `agents[].activity` | string |  | What it is doing right now, e.g. "Running tests" or "Edit lib/auth.mjs". |
| `agents[].activityKind` | string |  | What kind of work it is doing, for its animation in the office: edit (changing files), read, search, run (shell commands), test, think, web or idle. Optional: when missing or unknown, Flow infers it from activity (a tool name such as Edit, Read, Grep, Bash or WebFetch, or words such as "Running tests"); an idle agent is always idle. Shown for private agents too. One of `edit`, `read`, `search`, `run`, `test`, `think`, `web`, `idle`. |
| `agents[].host` | string |  | The machine, e.g. "laptop". |
| `agents[].hostLabel` | string |  | How to show where it runs, e.g. "laptop · T3". |
| `agents[].repo` | object | null |  | The repository it works in: matched against projects' repos to decide who may see the details. |
| `agents[].children` | object[] |  | Its subagents (up to 20 kept). |
| `agents[].pending` | object | null |  | What it waits on (only kept while status is waiting). |
| `agents[].agentflow` | object | null |  | The AgentFlow agent and card it works on, when the reporter knows: it then sits at that agent's desk in the office's common area. Resolved in each environment against its own agents and cards (elsewhere it keeps its own desk). Without it, Flow reads the title: "[Flow] <Agent>: #<n> …" (the agent runner's threads), or "#<n>" for a card delegated to exactly one agent. |
| `agents[].can` | string[] |  | What its owner may do from the office besides Allow / Deny: "message" (send it a message as a new user turn) and "stop" (interrupt its running turn). Only list what this reporter can carry out; [] or none when it can only be steered where it runs. |
| `agents[].transcript` | object[] |  | The latest lines of its conversation (the last 12 are kept, each cut to 400 characters), shown only to its owner: never to anyone else, whatever they can see. Mask secrets before sending; Flow masks tokens, keys, Authorization headers and .env-looking lines again. |
| `agents[].role` | string |  | conductor: this agent is its owner's Chief of Staff, a long-lived thread that takes their messages from the office, routes work to AgentFlow agents and answers questions. The office draws it as their companion. Always private to everyone but its owner (others see only that it is one, and its status), whatever its repo. Report at most one per person; list "message" in can. One of `conductor`. |
| `agents[].reply` | object | null |  | A conductor's latest reply, for its owner only (like transcript; masked again on the server): what the office shows in its bubble and log. |
| `agents[].usage` | object | null |  | Optional model use for today, as the reporter measured it. Omit the object when you do not measure use: the office meter then shows a dash. The office bridge does not send this yet. Someone who cannot see the agent does not receive it (they still see running or waiting). |
| `sources` | object[] | yes |  |
| `sources[].source` | string | yes |  |
| `sources[].at` | string | yes |  |
| `sources[].agents` | integer | yes |  |

**Example: Yours**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/office/agents" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "agents": [
    {
      "id": "laptop:t3:thread-abc",
      "title": "Fix login bug",
      "vendor": "claude",
      "model": "Opus 5.5",
      "status": "waiting",
      "activity": "Waiting for approval",
      "activityKind": "test",
      "host": "laptop",
      "hostLabel": "laptop · T3",
      "repo": {
        "name": "flow",
        "remote": "https://github.com/acme/flow.git"
      },
      "children": [],
      "pending": {
        "requestId": "req-1",
        "kind": "approval",
        "summary": "Run: npm test",
        "can": [
          "allow",
          "deny"
        ]
      },
      "agentflow": {
        "agent": "Builder",
        "card": 12
      },
      "can": [
        "message",
        "stop"
      ],
      "transcript": [
        {
          "role": "user",
          "text": "Fix the login redirect loop.",
          "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
        },
        {
          "role": "assistant",
          "text": "The callback keeps ?next=/login. Running the tests next.",
          "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
        },
        {
          "role": "tool",
          "text": "Run: npm test",
          "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
        }
      ],
      "source": "bridge:laptop"
    }
  ],
  "sources": [
    {
      "source": "bridge:laptop",
      "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
      "agents": 1
    }
  ]
}
```

### `office.actions.wait`

Wait for answers to your agents' prompts

`GET /api/v1/office/actions` · scope `write` · MCP tool `office_actions_wait`

Long-poll for the actions taken in the 3D office on this source's agents by their owner: returns as soon as one is queued, or an empty list after wait seconds (0 to 30; 0 answers at once). kind answer is Allow / Deny on pending.requestId (a missing kind is answer); message is text to send as a new user turn; stop interrupts its running turn (both only for agents whose can lists them). Each action is delivered once (here or in the office.agents.report answer). Check the agent is still the same and still yours, carry it out, then send the result with office.actions.result.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | string | yes | The reporter, e.g. "bridge:laptop". Each source replaces only its own agents. |
| `wait` | integer |  | Seconds to wait for an answer (0-30). |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `actions` | object[] | yes |  |
| `actions[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `actions[].agentId` | string | yes |  |
| `actions[].source` | string |  |  |
| `actions[].kind` | enum | yes | answer: Allow / Deny (requestId, decision); message: send text as a new user turn; stop: interrupt its running turn. Treat a missing kind as answer. One of `answer`, `message`, `stop`. |
| `actions[].requestId` | string |  | answer only. |
| `actions[].decision` | enum |  | answer only. One of `allow`, `deny`. |
| `actions[].text` | string |  | message only: what its owner wrote. |
| `actions[].at` | string | yes |  |
| `actions[].result` | object |  |  |

**Example: An answer**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/office/actions?source=bridge%3Alaptop&wait=25" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "actions": [
    {
      "id": "act_1",
      "agentId": "laptop:t3:thread-abc",
      "source": "bridge:laptop",
      "kind": "answer",
      "requestId": "req-1",
      "decision": "allow",
      "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

**Example: A message and a stop**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/office/actions?source=bridge%3Alaptop&wait=25" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "actions": [
    {
      "id": "act_2",
      "agentId": "laptop:t3:thread-abc",
      "source": "bridge:laptop",
      "kind": "message",
      "text": "Also add a test for it.",
      "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
    },
    {
      "id": "act_3",
      "agentId": "laptop:t3:thread-abc",
      "source": "bridge:laptop",
      "kind": "stop",
      "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

### `office.actions.result`

Say how an answer went

`POST /api/v1/office/actions/{id}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `office_actions_result`

The reporter carried out (or could not carry out) an action from office.actions.wait: the agent's owner sees the message in the office right away. Keep it short, and never echo a message's text.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | The action id (act_…). |
| `ok` | boolean | yes |  |
| `message` | string |  | e.g. "Approved in T3". |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | object | yes |  |
| `action.id` | string | yes |  |
| `action.agentId` | string | yes |  |
| `action.source` | string |  |  |
| `action.kind` | enum | yes | answer: Allow / Deny (requestId, decision); message: send text as a new user turn; stop: interrupt its running turn. Treat a missing kind as answer. One of `answer`, `message`, `stop`. |
| `action.requestId` | string |  | answer only. |
| `action.decision` | enum |  | answer only. One of `allow`, `deny`. |
| `action.text` | string |  | message only: what its owner wrote. |
| `action.at` | string | yes |  |
| `action.result` | object |  |  |

**Example: Done**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/office/actions/act_1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"ok":true,"message":"Approved in T3"}'
```

```json
{
  "action": {
    "id": "act_1",
    "agentId": "laptop:t3:thread-abc",
    "source": "bridge:laptop",
    "kind": "answer",
    "requestId": "req-1",
    "decision": "allow",
    "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
    "result": {
      "ok": true,
      "message": "Approved in T3",
      "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
    }
  }
}
```
